get.summary: Verify the event chain for a unit (§13.5)
get.description:
Recompute every hash and check seq continuity for `unit_id` in `org_id`.

This is a read-only operation.  It does not modify any data.

get.summary: Get evidence record for a unit (§15, §14.2)
get.description:
Return the evidence record for `unit_id` in the caller's org.

Returns 404 when no record exists or the unit belongs to another org.

schema.title: Response Get Return Evidence Api V1 Units  Unit Id  Return Evidence Get

get.summary: All evidence record versions for a unit (§15)
get.description: Return all record versions (v1 … vN) for `unit_id`, in ascending order.

schema.title: Response Get Return Evidence History Api V1 Units  Unit Id  Return Evidence History Get

get.description:
Bulk export finalized evidence records as JSONL or flat CSV.

JSONL: one record per line (RFC 8259).
CSV: flat view with official column order (§14.3).

api_key.description: Shown once. Store it now; it cannot be retrieved again.
